tasks.purpose: 比较两条公交线路的乘客数量
tasks.setting:
The line chart below shows the average number of passengers using two bus routes in a town on each weekday in one sample week. The figures refer to passengers per day, rather than individual people, and include journeys in both directions.

Line chart: average passengers per day
Weekday       Mon  Tue  Wed  Thu  Fri
Route A       120  140  160  180  200
Route B       200  190  180  170  160
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两条线路的主要变化，选择数据比较乘客数量。
tasks.model:
The line chart compares the average daily number of passengers on two bus routes in a town over one working week. The figures count journeys on each day and cover travel in both directions.

Overall, use of Route A rose steadily, whereas Route B experienced a gradual decline. Route B carried more passengers at the beginning of the week, but Route A became the busier of the two routes by Thursday.

On Monday, Route A recorded 120 passengers, compared with 200 on Route B, a difference of 80. The number on the first route then increased by 20 each day, reaching 140 on Tuesday and 160 on Wednesday. It continued to climb to 180 on Thursday and ended the week at 200, an overall rise of 80 passengers.

By contrast, Route B fell by 10 passengers per day, from 200 on Monday to 180 on Wednesday. It still had 20 more passengers than Route A at that point. The following day, however, its figure dropped to 170, ten below Route A. By Friday it had fallen to 160, leaving a gap of 40 in favour of Route A.

tasks.purpose: 比较两个图书馆的借阅量
tasks.setting:
The line chart below gives the annual number of books borrowed from two branch libraries over five years. The figures are expressed in thousands of loans and cover the books issued by each branch during the calendar year shown.

Line chart: annual loans (thousands)
Year          2018  2019  2020  2021  2022
East branch     20    25    30    35    40
West branch     35    30    25    25    30
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两馆借阅量的变化，选择数据比较趋势。
tasks.model:
The line chart presents the number of books borrowed annually from two library branches between 2018 and 2022. All figures are given in thousands of loans.

Overall, lending at the East branch increased consistently throughout the period. The West branch, by contrast, declined at first before recovering in the final year. Although West began with more loans, East overtook it and finished well ahead.

In 2018, East issued 20,000 books, while West recorded 35,000 loans, making the latter higher by 15,000. East's figure rose by 5,000 in each subsequent year, reaching 25,000 in 2019 and 30,000 in 2020. It then continued upwards to 35,000 and finally 40,000 in 2022, twice its starting level.

West followed a different pattern. Its annual total fell from 35,000 to 30,000 in 2019 and then to 25,000 in 2020. This was the year in which East moved ahead, by 5,000 loans. West remained at 25,000 in 2021 before recovering to 30,000 at the end of the period. Nevertheless, the gap in 2022 was 10,000 loans in East's favour.
